Are these the same entity? Vishay Israel Ltd. Transducers was formerly known as... Actually, Vishay Israel's transducers division became Vishay Precision Group (VPG). However, they might be the same corporate family... The register entry likely was derived from a different source or older name. This is more than that — it's a different name entirely (possibly same underlying operation rebranded, but from a data fusion standpoint, the certificate is authoritative). Given the rules, I'd say "different-entity" with best_value = document value. The register's name appears to be an outdated/alternate rendering; the certificate's own text is the legal instrument.
